title: CompassSport Final 2018
text: The Walton Chasers club, which is hosting the CompassSport Final this October, has already circulated preliminary information about the event, to be held in Abraham's Valley, Cannock Chase. Sarah is busy collecting names of those who plan to compete for the club, so please email her at captain@suffoc.co.uk to add yourself to the list. All members are welcome, whatever your level of experience 🙂
